capabilities: Browse properties in a key → value → note tree
Open notes from the property tree
Search across keys, values, and note titles
Sort keys and values by name or frequency
extras: The manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice; the README's Demo section contains no usable content.
intentEvidence: an expandable right-pane view that lets you explore all properties across your vault
problem: Obsidian's Properties view works per-note, so there is no built-in way to browse every property key and value used across the whole vault.
summary: Right-pane tree view that indexes all properties across a vault, browsable by key → value → note, with search and sorting.
